# Frostrek AI
> AI workflow delivery, full-stack development, and automation company
> Founded by Akash Mittal | Based in Gurugram, India | 18+ team members
> 5+ years AI delivery | 50+ trained specialists

## About
Frostrek AI is an AI-first technology company that delivers end-to-end AI workflow automation, conversational AI agents, and full-stack development services. Founded by Akash Mittal, Frostrek AI operates as an exclusive technical partner — not a body-shopping agency — providing architecture-to-deployment solutions for startups, mid-market companies, and enterprises globally.

## Core Services
- Conversational AI Agents (Frosty Robo — plug-and-play SaaS bot for WhatsApp, Slack, and web chat, deployable in under 48 hours)
- AI-Powered Video Interviews (Hiyring — hiyring.com — conducts multilingual AI video interviews simultaneously, reducing screening time by 80% for high-volume hiring)
- Full-Stack AI Development & Automation
- Fintech & Custom Wallet Development (digital wallets, payment infrastructure, stablecoin platforms, KYC/AML, DeFi integrations)
- E-Commerce Solutions & Cross-Border Trade
- Enterprise AI Copilots & Workflow Automation
- AI Data Operations (annotation, RLHF, SFT fine-tuning for frontier LLMs)
- Voice AI Agents for customer support and sales

## Products
- Frosty Robo: Conversational AI agent platform — integrates with WhatsApp, Slack, and web chat in under 48 hours
- Hiyring (hiyring.com): Autonomous AI video interview platform — screens 500+ candidates simultaneously in 30+ languages
- Voice AI Agent: Human-like voice interactions for support and sales automation
- Fintech & Custom Wallets: Production-grade digital wallets, payment infrastructure, stablecoin platforms, KYC/AML integration, and DeFi — https://www.frostrek.ai/solutions/fintech-custom-wallets
- LinkedIn Automation: Smart outreach scaling for B2B sales teams
- ERPNext AI Modules: Intelligent add-ons for enterprise ERP systems

## Key Differentiators
- Exclusive technical partner model (not body-shopping)
